scope.counting: Unique source configurations globally. Employer feeds are shared, read once and checked for each supported country. Monitoring capability does not establish current hiring or guarantee job counts.
scope.sourceRequirement: Public employer feed returned published jobs at verification time; matching software jobs and country eligibility are measured separately.
scope.jobRequirement: Fully remote software jobs with explicit US, UK or Ireland eligibility, including confirmed worldwide eligibility. No paid API or AI calls.

attributions.author: Elliott Dehn / Open Jobs
attributions.changes: Employer identifiers only from the frozen directory, independently verified at live employer endpoints. No snapshot postings, inferred country eligibility, embeddings or upstream code are imported.
